description: CSRF protection and HttpOnly secure cookies must remain enabled.
Foreign key integrity and audit timestamps must be maintained on all entity updates.
Production UI and database must never contain synthetic, mocked or fake price data. If price is unknown or unverified, display empty/unverified state.
verificationMethod: Code review, DB inspection, audit_truthful_ui test

description: No bypassing of Microsoft authentication or tokens. Only use public unauthenticated Display Catalog / discovery endpoints.
Strict rate-limiting, jitter backoff, max concurrency 2, batch size 25, no anti-bot bypass or proxy rotation.
verificationMethod: Rate limiter unit test and collector configuration inspection

description: Phase 1 focuses exclusively on the Xbox Microsoft Store Turkey market (market=TR, language=tr-TR, currency TRY).
Track only 300-600 popular and important paid games. Exclude free games, DLCs, add-ons, skins, consumables, sound-tracks.
verificationMethod: Free-game and product-type filter unit tests

description: Do not write production implementation before validating Xbox Display Catalog endpoints, TR pricing paths, SKU handling, and batch behavior with real API evidence.
Strictly stop at Phase 1 scope. Do not implement Phase 2 items like Telegram, Auth, Watchlists, Redis, microservices.
verificationMethod: Scope audit and acceptance report review

description: Phase 1 uses only PostgreSQL for storage, sync locks, and cache if needed. Redis is strictly forbidden in Phase 1.
No user authentication, sessions, logins or user accounts in Phase 1. Open public data portal only.
No Telegram bot token, message sender, bot webhook or subscription code in Phase 1. Only architecture readiness allowed.
DLC, add-on, expansion, currency, or consumable products must never be classified or displayed as base games in the default deals catalog.
verificationMethod: Product classification unit test and deals query inspection

description: No guessing or fuzzy title parsing for game-addon or bundle-child relationships. Relationships must be strictly grounded in Microsoft Display Catalog metadata.
verificationMethod: Relationship source audit and relation mapper unit tests
